test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He has a high paying job, ______________ he never seems to have any money.
solution:
The correct answer is **Yet.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Yet" is used to link two opposite ideas together.
 
• The complete sentence will be, **"He has a high paying job, yet he never seems to have any money."**
 
• Other examples of "yet" include, *He is a hard hard-working student, yet he cannot do well in the exam*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**By**" is generally used to **denote how a thing is done**. It is generally used before a noun.

 
 
• **Example**: I will go there by bus.
 
 
 
• "**By**" is also used to **refer to a particular point in time**.
 
 
• **Example:** *He will be there by 3 p.m*.
 
 
 
• "**From**" is used to **signify a place or time from where or when something has begun**.
 
 
• **Example**- **He is from Germany**.
 
 
 
• **"So"** is used to **introduce a result of something**.
 
 
• **Example**- *He missed the train. So he couldn't come to the office in time*.
 
 
 
• "**So**" is also used to **signify the amount of something**.
 
 
• **Example**- *He is so weak that he cannot walk a single step.*
